name: Lighting Transfer Function
aliases: Illustrative Enhancement via 2D Lighting Transfer Function
definition: A 2D lookup table storing ambient, diffuse, specular, and opacity enhancement components based on dot products of normalized gradient, light vector, and half-way vector, allowing various shading models to be evaluated at constant cost.
summary: The Lighting Transfer Function is a 2D lookup table technique that decouples complex illustrative shading from the ray marching loop, enabling constant-cost evaluation and style swapping without altering the rendering algorithm.
